scripts.text:
[Crewman]
Hey, have you heard of a place called Brasilis?
It's a tropical city that's hot like the desert but also rainy. It is a very mysterious place.
scripts.translation:
[船员]
嘿，你听说过巴西吗？
那是一座热带城市，热得像沙漠，但雨水也很多。那里非常神秘。

scripts.text:
[Crewman]
We recently found a new ocean route to get there easily.
It's just 10,000 zeny for a round trip, and 1,000 for VIP! So do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[船员]
我们最近发现了一条通往那里的新航线，非常方便。
往返只要10,000 Zeny，VIP只要1,000 Zeny！你想去吗？

scripts.text:
[Crewman]
We recently found a new ocean route to get there easily.
It's just 10,000 zeny for a round trip! So do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[船员]
我们最近发现了一条通往那里的新航线，非常方便。
往返只要10,000 Zeny！你想去吗？

scripts.text: Take me to Brasilis!
scripts.translation: 带我去巴西！

scripts.text: I'll stay here.
scripts.translation: 我就待在这里。

scripts.text:
[Crewman]
I said {0} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[船员]
我说了是{0} Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Crewman]
Cool~!! Let's go~!
scripts.translation:
[船员]
好耶~！我们出发吧~！

scripts.text:
[Crewman]
Well if you're ever interested, let me know and I can take you there.
scripts.translation:
[船员]
如果你以后想去的话，告诉我一声，我可以带你去。

scripts.text:
[Crewman]
My ship is going to back to Alberta, do you want to join us?
scripts.translation:
[船员]
我的船要回艾尔贝塔了，你要一起吗？

scripts.text: Go back to Alberta.
scripts.translation: 返回艾尔贝塔。

scripts.text: Not yet~.
scripts.translation: 暂时不去~。

scripts.text:
[Crewman]
I sure do miss home.
scripts.translation:
[船员]
我真的很想念家乡。

scripts.text:
[Crewman]
Ok, suit yourself. We'll see you when we get back then.
scripts.translation:
[船员]
好吧，随你。那我们下次见。

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
Come~come~
Ice cream is the perfect snack for a hot day~
It's just ^3355FF100 Zeny^000000~
Ice Cream~
Get 'yer Ice Cream!
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋师]
来~来~
冰淇淋是炎热天气的完美点心~
只要^3355FF100 Zeny^000000~
冰淇淋~
快来买冰淇淋吧！

scripts.text: Give me one!
scripts.translation: 给我一个！

scripts.text: Ice Cream?
scripts.translation: 冰淇淋？

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
Since there are so many people want to get a cool ice cream you can order only 5 at a time.
So how many d'ya want?
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋师]
因为想吃清凉冰淇淋的人太多了，所以一次只能订购5个。
那么，你要几个呢？

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
None?
Fine get outta the way, I have customers to serve.
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋师]
不要？
好吧，让开点，我还有别的顾客要招待。

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
Wow.
You ordered too much.
If you eat over 5 you might need to fight with a monster in your stomach. Calm down buddy.
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋师]
哇。
你订太多了。
如果一次吃超过5个，肚子里可能会跟魔物打架哦。冷静点，巴迪。

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
Dood~! You don't have enough money.
It's only ^3355FF100 Zeny^000000~ Seriously!
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋师]
哎呀~！你的钱不够。
只要^3355FF100 Zeny^000000~ 认真的！

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
You seem to have too much stuff.
Lighten your pack before buying this.
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋师]
你好像带了太多东西。
买这个之前先减轻一下负重吧。

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
'Ice cream is...
Wait, don't you know
what Ice Cream is?
What rock have you
been living under?
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋师]
“冰淇淋是...
等等，你不知道
冰淇淋是什么吗？
你一直住在哪个岩石下面吗？

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
I'm not going to even start with how weird that sounds.
Anyway, get 'yer Ice Cream right here while it's nice and cold.
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋师]
我就不提那听起来有多奇怪了。
总之，趁现在还冰着，快来买你的冰淇淋吧。

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
Don't miss your chance to eat the greatest Ice Cream in all the land~!
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋师]
别错过品尝全大陆最棒冰淇淋的机会~！
